assessment: This paper addresses an interesting and important topic bearing on the initiation of labor at the end of pregnancy. It tests a hypothesis invoking interleukin-33 in uterine smooth muscle in the third trimester of pregnancy in an endoplasmic reticular stress. This in turn results in an alteration of ca2+ homeostasis that might be involved in initiating labor. The study was made in human myometrial cells enhancing its clinical translatability.
